what: Parameter Classes for Data Analysis Operations — markersParam-class
title: Parameter Classes for Data Analysis Operations — markersParam-class
text: Parameter classes use [analyzeData()]. class encodes specific analysis method settings. Pass [analyzeData()] directly via [analyzeParam()] factory function. params produce computed values (scores, statistics). downstream thresholding selection separate step. **Stat params** (per-feature per-cell summaries): - `featStatsParam` — per-feature: nr_cells, perc_cells, mean_expr,   mean_expr_det, total_expr - `cellStatsParam` — per-cell: nr_feats, perc_feats, total_expr **COV-based score params** (coefficient variation scores): - `covGroupsParam` — COV z-score within expression-level bins - `covLoessParam` — residual COV LOESS fit COV ~ log(mean_expr) **Variance param**: - `varParam` — per-feature variance analytic Pearson residuals,   computed raw counts **Marker detection params** (one subclass virtual `markersParam` per detection method): - `scranMarkersParam` — pairwise group comparisons combined per group;   see [markers_scran]. Built [markersParam()]. - `giniMarkersParam` — per-group specificity Gini coefficient, derived   `featStatsParam`; see [markers_gini]. Built [markersParam()].

title: normalizeGiotto — normalizeGiotto
text: Currently two 'methods' normalize raw counts data. . standard method follows standard protocol can adjusted using provided parameters follows following order: 1. Data normalization total library size scaling custom scale-factor. 2. Log transformation data. 3. Z-scoring data genes /cells. B. normalization method provided osmFISH paper also implemented: 1. First normalize genes, gene divide counts total gene count multiply total number genes. 2. Next normalize cells, cell divide normalized gene counts total counts per cell multiply total number cells. C. normalization method provided Lause/Kobak et al also implemented: 1. First calculate expected values based Pearson correlations. 2. Next calculate z-scores based observed expected values. D. Quantile normalization across features 1. Rank feature expression 2. Define common distribution sorting expression values per feature finding mean across features per index 3. Apply common distribution expression information using ranks step 1 indices default latter two results saved Giotto slot scaled expression, can changed changing update_slot parameters

title: Data Processing Parameter Classes — process_param
text: Data processing operations Giotto Suite can divided normalization, scaling, adjustments. operations can selected via factory functions normParam(), scaleParam(), adjustParam(), respectively. Requested operations generated method-specific param classes contain parameters needed perform , editable $<-. Construct `filterParam` carrying cell + feature filter thresholds used [filterGiotto()]. `filterGiotto` builds internally; direct use needed computing masks standalone matrix. Returns `list(feats_keep, cells_keep)` character ID vectors passed [filterData()]. Construct `pcaParam` use [reduceData()]. `runPCA()` builds internally; direct use needed computing PCA standalone matrix. Returns list `u`, `d`, `v`, `sdev` passed `reduceData()`.

title: Data Processing Parameter Classes — process_param
text: method one `"auto"`, `"random"`, `"irlba"`, `"exact"`. `"auto"` defers choice substrate: -memory backends resolve `"irlba"`; streaming backends (`parquetExprStore` GiottoDisk) resolve `"random"` / `"gram-eigen"` per heuristics. ... (optional) Additional named parameters relevant param class. expression_threshold numeric. value `>= expression_threshold` counts detected. Default `1`. feat_det_in_min_cells integer. Keep features detected least many cells. Default `100`. min_det_feats_per_cell integer. Keep cells least many detected features (counted kept features — Giotto's two-stage convention). Default `100`. ncp number components. Default `50`. center logical. Center columns. Default `TRUE`. scale logical. Scale columns SD. Default `TRUE`. Streaming backends (parquetExprStore) ignore — scaling densifies matrix incompatible O(N*k) streaming. feats_to_use character vector feature IDs subset PCA. `NULL` means features. Useful HVG selection. n_oversamples integer. Halko oversampling parameter `random`. Default `10`. n_power_iter integer. Halko power iterations `random`. Default `2`. set_seed logical. Default `TRUE`. seed_number integer. Default `1234`. dry_run logical. meaningful `method = "auto"`. `TRUE`, `reduceData(x, param)` returns substrate-resolved concrete `pcaParam` instead running PCA. Useful inspecting testing substrate's method selection. Default `FALSE`. ... reserved.

title: Giotto 4.2.4 (in development)
text: findScranMarkers_one_vs_all() returns cluster character. findMarkers_one_vs_all() methods now agree type, results can joined stacked cluster regardless method; previously scran disagreed gini. Code comparing numeric literal needs "3" rather 3. Note method = "mast" labels comparison ("3_vs_others") rather bare cluster id, joins across mast others still need translation step. calculateHVF(method = "var_p_resid") now computes analytic Pearson residuals , raw counts, instead taking plain variance whatever matrix handed. Selected features differ previous releases. Previously residual criterion required running normalizeGiotto(norm_methods = "pearson_resid") first passing expression_values = "scaled" (slot normalization writes , "normalized" default) — three-way agreement nothing verified, silently returned variance library-normalized values whenever met. expression_values now ignored method, warning set explicitly. normalizeGiotto(norm_methods = "pearson_resid") unaffected remains available producing residuals stored matrix. analyzeData(x, varParam) correspondingly returns residual variance, gained mean_expr column. gains theta parameter (default 100, following Lause/Kobak matching normalizeGiotto()); calculateHVF() exposes argument. IterableMatrix (BPCells) input now errors rather silently returning different statistic. calculateHVF() gains n_top_feats (default 2000), top-N cut applies three methods, combined method’s threshold restrictive one decides. var_number deprecated favour — old name implied variance cut now method-agnostic. method ranks score: residual variance, within-bin COV z-score, COV LOESS fit. cov_groups z-score standardised within expression bins, global ranking stays balanced across expression levels (top-2000 cut Stereo-seq transcriptome drew 9.6-12.4% 19 20 bins; highest-expression bin -represented COV compressed construction). practice cov_loess changes default — 6,043 features selected , 2,000 now — since cov_groups’s zscore_threshold already stricter count. calculateHVF(method = "var_p_resid") selection defaults change n_top_feats = 2000 (count) var_threshold = 1 (1.5), two now applied together rather count overriding threshold. restrictive constraint decides; passing NULL either falls back . old defaults selected variance alone cut sits essentially median corrected distribution — measured 1.496 Stereo-seq cellbin sample, 1.5 took 9,696 19,558 features. var_threshold = 1 now noise floor (Pearson residuals variance 1 -signal expectation) rather selector, var_number sets size. targeted panel, var_number bind — Xenium’s 528 features — floor applies, keeping 433 noise. findScranMarkers_one_vs_all()’s logFC threshold now takes effect. filter read logFC >= logFC, sides resolved result column rather argument, comparison always TRUE threshold silently ignored — features kept pval min_feats alone. Fewer features returned previous releases; pass logFC = -Inf restore old behaviour exactly (logFC = 0 equivalent — still drops -regulated features, broken comparison kept). Leiden entry points now default n_iterations = 20: doLeidenCluster(), doLeidenClusterIgraph(), doLeidenClusterPython(), subClusterCells() (1000) doLeidenSubCluster() (500). Measured ARI 0.97 1000-iteration partition 159k-cell Xenium dataset, ~50x speed. See accessors.R New filterDistributions() generate histogram plots expression statistics
